newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian state bank to launch new mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian state bank to launch new mutual fund.

text.p: Banque du Caire, one of Egypt's big four state-owned banks, is planning to launch its second close-ended mutual fund, a senior bank official said on Tuesday.
"The dividend-paying fund will be launched within two months, depending on official approvals,"the official, who asked not to be named, told Reuters.
Hermes Fund Management(HFM) will manage the new fund. HFM is the manager of the bank's first capital-growth fund, one of the best performing in Egypt.
"The second fund is aimed at another category of investors, paying a dividend every six months," the official said.
Subscribers can buy at least five units in the fund, which will have a minimum capital of 100 million pounds ($29 million) the official added. The unit is priced at 100 pounds.
The bank is also planning to increase the capital of its first fund, but no final proposals have yet been drawn up, the official said.
Fifteen local mutual funds, apart from foreign funds investing in the country, are performing very well on the market, with share prices hitting record levels every day.
